title: Static Asymmetric Oval-Fringed Flatfish
description: One newly authored complete stylised flatfish-like animal in a fixed low resting display. A genuinely low thick asymmetric oval-diamond body narrows at a small offset front mouth and at a short rear tail stock. Two long continuous finite-thickness fin margins follow its opposite long sides, ending before a separate small rounded broad tail fan; both small eyes sit on the same upward-facing head surface with a staggered offset. All body sections, unequal side outlines, long fin ribbons and short tail are authored together, not a fusiform fish rotated on its side, a ray with its whip tail removed or a cuttlefish without arms. Real closed thickness and a finite belly datum, no painted silhouette or alpha membrane. One whole static model zero scenes.
